in_sanskrit.name: अखिल

in_hindi.long_meaning: पूर्ण होना - To be complete, To be full

in_tamil.name: அகில்
in_tamil.long_meaning: அருகிருக்குவது - To cover all, To be comprehensive

in_marathi.name: Akhil
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Entire, Whole, Complete
in_marathi.long_meaning: Akhil हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Akhil is a Sanskrit name derived from the term 'Akha' meaning 'entire' or 'whole'. It is a powerful name that signifies completeness and perfection. In Hindu mythology, Akhil is an epithet for Lord Vishnu, who is considered the preserver of the universe. The name is believed to bring good fortune, happiness, and success to the one who bears it.
